case-study-details.label: Challenge
case-study-details.body: A mid-sized retail bank was losing 8% of its active current-account holders per quarter with no clear understanding of why. The existing reporting flagged churn after it happened, giving the retention team nothing to act on.

case-study-details.label: Approach
case-study-details.body: Abubakar facilitated discovery workshops with the retention, data, and product teams to align on the definition of 'at-risk'. He then designed a structured data request, pulling 18 months of transaction frequency, support ticket history, and product usage signals from three separate systems.

case-study-details.label: Analysis
case-study-details.body: Using SQL for extraction and Power BI for visualisation, he identified three leading behavioural indicators that preceded churn by an average of 58 days: declining direct-debit activity, a spike in balance-enquiry calls, and dormancy in the mobile app.

case-study-details.label: Solution
case-study-details.body: Abubakar authored a prioritised intervention playbook mapping each risk tier to a specific retention action — proactive outreach, fee waiver offer, or product switch recommendation — and presented it to the Head of Retail and the CMO.

case-study-details.label: Results
case-study-details.body: Within one quarter of implementation, churn dropped by 22%. The retention team reported that the playbook gave them a shared language and a clear decision framework for the first time. The model was subsequently adopted by two other product lines.

case-study-details.label: Tools Used
case-study-details.body: SQL (PostgreSQL), Power BI, Excel, Miro (workshop facilitation), Confluence (documentation), PowerPoint (executive presentation)

homePage.aboutBody: I'm Abubakar — a Business Analyst who thrives at the intersection of strategy, data, and people. I translate ambiguous business challenges into structured requirements, measurable outcomes, and solutions that actually get built. Whether I'm mapping stakeholder journeys, facilitating discovery workshops, or stress-testing a process model, I bring analytical rigour and clear communication to every engagement. I believe the best BA work is invisible — when the right solution ships on time and everyone wonders why it felt so smooth.
